items.quote: And I bowed down my head, and worshipped the LORD, and blessed the LORD God of my master Abraham, which had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter unto his son.
items.claim: Abraham's servant, speaking in the first person, says he bowed his head, worshipped and blessed the LORD God of his master Abraham. He credits God with leading him the right way to get his master's brother's daughter as a wife for Abraham's son.
items.action: bowed down, worshipped, and blessed the LORD
items.object: the LORD God of Abraham; the bride for Abraham's son (daughter of Abraham's brother's line)
items.mechanism: divine guidance: the LORD 'had led me in the right way'
